pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the sendmail daemon.

run_as_user.description: User account under which the sendmail daemon runs.

run_as_group.description: Group under which the sendmail daemon runs.

queue_directory.description: Directory where mail queue files are stored.

temp_directory.description: Directory used for temporary queue files (e.g., message bodies).

listeners.description: List of addresses and ports on which the SMTP daemon listens.

address.description: IP address (IPv4 or IPv6) or hostname to bind to. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces.

port.description: SMTP port (typically 25 for submission, 465 for SMTPS, 587 for submission).

my_hostname.description: Fully qualified domain name (FQDN) of this host — used in SMTP banner and envelope.

domain_masquerade.description: If set, rewrite outbound addresses to appear as if from this domain (e.g., 'example.com').

max_daemon_children.description: Maximum number of child processes (delivery agents) spawned concurrently.

queue_interval.description: Seconds between automatic queue runs (0 = disable automatic queue runs; rely on cron or manual `sendmail -q`)

max_message_size.description: Maximum accepted message size in bytes (0 = no limit). Recommended: 10 MB (10485760 bytes).

blacklist_files.description: List of paths to file-based blacklist (e.g., `sendmail.blacklist`) used to reject known spam sources.

restricted_relay.description: If true, only allow relay from hosts listed in `relay_file`.

relay_file.description: Path to file listing hosts permitted to relay mail (only used if restricted_relay=true).

log_level.description: Logging verbosity: 0 (minimal) to 14 (debug). Higher values increase log detail.

log_smtp_transactions.description: If true, log full SMTP session (commands and responses) to the mail log.

trusted_user.description: User allowed to submit mail directly (e.g., via `sendmail`) without queuing (dangerous for non-root).

alias_file.description: Path to the aliases database (must be compiled with `newaliases`).

map_directory.description: Directory containing hash/DB maps for mailertable, virtuser, genericstable, etc.

tls_cert.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format). If empty, TLS is disabled.

tls_key.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format).

tls_ca.description: Path to CA certificate bundle (for validating client/server certs).

tls_options.description: TLS options (e.g., `+SSLv23 +TLSv1`), or empty for defaults. Avoid weak protocols like `+SSLv2`.

starttls_enabled.description: If true, enable SMTPS (port 465) alongside regular SMTP (port 25).

delivery_mode_retry_interval.description: Seconds between delivery attempts for unreachable hosts (min retry backoff).
